description: Event Description — Cybersecurity Hackathon Step into the world of cybersecurity, innovation, and problem-solving with an exciting hackathon designed to bring together developers, innovators, and aspiring cybersecurity enthusiasts to build solutions for real-world digital challenges. With Cybersecurity as the central theme, this hackathon aims to encourage participants to explore emerging threats, strengthen digital security, and develop innovative solutions that make the digital world safer. The event will be conducted across two competitive rounds : Round 1: Online — Open Innovation in Cybersecurity Participants will have complete creative freedom to identify a cybersecurity challenge and develop an innovative solution around it. Teams must build and submit a working MVP addressing any relevant area of cybersecurity. Submissions will be evaluated based on innovation, technical execution, problem-solving approach, and potential real-world impact. Round 2: Final Round — Delhi NCR (Hybrid) The top 250–300 participants shortlisted from Round 1 will advance to the final round. Unlike Round 1, participants will be presented with a specific cybersecurity problem statement that they must tackle through their technical knowledge, creativity, and implementation skills. The final round will be conducted in a hybrid format (online and offline) , with offline participation hosted in Delhi NCR. The exact venue will be revealed to shortlisted participants. Whether your interest lies in ethical hacking, AI-powered security, threat detection, data privacy, network protection, or emerging digital vulnerabilities, this is your opportunity to turn ideas into impactful solutions. Identify the threat. Engineer the solution. Secure the future.

Event Description — Cybersecurity Hackathon

  • Step into the world of cybersecurity, innovation, and problem-solving with an exciting hackathon designed to bring together developers, innovators, and aspiring cybersecurity enthusiasts to build solutions for real-world digital challenges.
  • With Cybersecurity as the central theme, this hackathon aims to encourage participants to explore emerging threats, strengthen digital security, and develop innovative solutions that make the digital world safer.

The event will be conducted across two competitive rounds:

Round 1: Online — Open Innovation in Cybersecurity

Participants will have complete creative freedom to identify a cybersecurity challenge and develop an innovative solution around it. Teams must build and submit a working MVP addressing any relevant area of cybersecurity. Submissions will be evaluated based on innovation, technical execution, problem-solving approach, and potential real-world impact.

Round 2: Final Round — Delhi NCR (Hybrid)

The top 250–300 participants shortlisted from Round 1 will advance to the final round. Unlike Round 1, participants will be presented with a specific cybersecurity problem statement that they must tackle through their technical knowledge, creativity, and implementation skills.

The final round will be conducted in a hybrid format (online and offline), with offline participation hosted in Delhi NCR. The exact venue will be revealed to shortlisted participants.

Whether your interest lies in ethical hacking, AI-powered security, threat detection, data privacy, network protection, or emerging digital vulnerabilities, this is your opportunity to turn ideas into impactful solutions.

Identify the threat. Engineer the solution. Secure the future.
